==Basic Premise of the Article==
I have a problem with the very first line in the article.  Rebirth in the Wheel of Time is not meant (or perhaps "believed" would be a better term) to be a rare occurrence, limited only to heroes and persons with special purposes.  I base this on the common use of the oath:  "I swear by the Light and my hope of rebirth..." the most solemn and binding oath a citizen of the Wheel can make. The common belief is that rebirth is available to everyone, though what the decision to return to the mortal coil and who or Who makes that decision is not really addressed.  I'm trying to say, we really know a lot less about rebirth in the WOT universe than this article leads us to believe.[[User:Pedantic|Pedantic]] 17:20, 18 June 2008 (UTC)
